title: Poor Engineering
text: Poor Engineering. I always have high hopes that these things will be better than they are. This rack is held together by ONE hinky screw that doesn't even go all the way through the metal because the pieces are bent and don't line up.  The picture shows this stacked with kindling too. In actuality it holds about 3 pieces of real wood.
